source_read: the product pages on https://www.mcdonalds.com/gb/en-gb/product/<slug>.html (each prints a 'Nutritional Information' table per portion)
method: Independent second read in the founder's Chrome: the table of each page was brought into view and read from a zoomed screenshot (the page's accessibility tree omits the fat, carbohydrate and protein cells, so text extraction cannot be used). 15 rows drawn at random (seed 31) from data/source/mcdonalds; kJ, kcal, fat, saturates, carbohydrates, sugars, fibre, protein and salt of each were compared with items.csv.
result: 15 of 15 rows match on every nutrient figure. Allergens were not re-read in this pass (they come from the bold words in each product's Ingredients & Allergens panel; 12 products print none, which is why the chain's allergens stay link-only). The Cappuccino salt figure (34 g) was seen again earlier on the page and the two rows stay held back.
